seo.title: Every DOM VIRUS game: play free on your page
seo.description: Tiny open-source arcade games that play on a real webpage: embedded games, board games and what's coming next. Play free in your browser.

sections.heading: Every game
sections.body: Every DOM VIRUS game starts as an idea page and becomes a tiny game you play right on the page. The best ones grow into a full board game on their own site. Pick a cartridge, press Play, and hit Recall to give the page back.

sections.heading: Board games

items.title: DOM Battlefield
items.body: Squad tactics: Sherman Bytes with a whole platoon. Plan every route, then command your squad under fire.

items.title: Battlefield Blitz
items.body: The arcade version: every crew for itself, parachute drops, airstrikes, most kills wins.

sections.headingAccent: The big versions, on their own sites.

items.title: DOM Kaiju
items.body: A giant pixel gorilla climbs your page from the footer to the top while helicopters swarm.

items.title: Everything next
items.body: The next cartridges in build order and the engine work behind them.
